describes: packages/core/acrojs createScriptHost: the per-document realm mutex, lazy boot, fault ladder and disposal, over a scripted sandbox.

cases.name: kernel-destroy-owns-host
cases.covers: Kernel destroy invokes the probe cleanup and releases the constructed sandbox once.
cases.reason: The script host runs under a probe plugin with no slice. These cases compare each transaction's outcome and settlement and the sandbox calls the probe logs as callbacks.
